diagram_previews.alt: Cross-section of two touching circles: a large one with centre O1 and radius 9 and a small one with centre O2 and radius 3, centres 12 apart on a dashed line. The red band follows the outer common tangents and wraps around both circles; blue dashed radii O1T1 (9) and O2T2 (3) go to the tangent points of the upper tangent segment T1T2, labelled 6 root 3. A dotted segment from O2 perpendicular to O1T1 and a blue arc marking the 60 degree angle at O1 complete the right triangle.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
